description: CDC weekly provisional deaths by state and cause (NCHS dataset muzy-jte6). Returns all-cause and selected-cause death counts per state per ISO week. Useful for excess-mortality and respiratory-disease seasonality analysis.

cause.description: Cause category (e.g. 'All Cause', 'COVID-19 (U071, Multiple Cause of Death)', 'Influenza and pneumonia')

state.description: Full state name or 'United States' for national. Default 'United States'.

name: cdc_weekly_deaths_by_state
